items.model: Æt nīehstan se cyning geswāc rīces.
Hē hæfde ðæt rīce fēowertig gēara.
Hwonne wurdon ðā brycga geworht?
Tō-dæg ðū bist mid mē.
Hwæt geworhton Rōmane on Breotone?
Ic sęnde mīnne ęngel beforan ðīnum andwlitan.
Cum, and bring ðā gewritu ðe ðū write.
Ic gehāte ēow gehīersumnesse, gif gē mē helpen.
Sęnd mē micelne hęre.
Ic feohte wið mīne fīend.
Ādrīfað ēowre fīend.
Ðā cęmpan fōron hām.
Hē cymð mid sciphęre.
Sleah ealle ðā ðe ðū gemētst.
Se hærfest is welig on wæstmum.
Sǣdtīma and hærfest ne geswīcað nǣfre.
Ðæt gēar hæfð fēower tīda.
Sēo eorðe is dryhtnes.
Se sǣ geseah, and hē flēah.
Hē flīehð ðæt īserne wǣpen.
Sē ðe nis scēaphierde, and nāh ðā scēap, ðonne hē gesiehð ðone wulf, ðonne flīehð hē, and forlǣtt ðā scēap, and se wulf nimð ðā scēap.
Se dæg is ðīn, sēo niht is ēac ðīn; ðū hæfst ðā sunnan and ðone mōnan gierwed; ðū hæfst ðā gemǣru ðǣre eorðan sętt; ðū hæfst sumer and winter geworht.
Gewyrcen wē ðās ceastra, and gewyrcen ābūtan hīe weallas, and torras, and gatu, ðā-hwīle-ðe ðæt land is gīet beforan ūs.
Ðās ðēoda sindon mā ðonne ic; hū mæg ic hīe ādrīfan?
Gā tō ðǣre sǣ, and weorp angel, and nim ðone ǣrestan fisc, and geopena his mūð.
Ðū gemētst pęning; nim ðone, and sęle for mē and for ðē.
Ðā cwæð hē, Hēo nis dēad.
Ðā nōm hē hiere hand, and cwæð, Fǣmne, rīs.
Se stānweall is seofon fōta brād, and twēntig fōta hēah.
Ic grētte hīe, and cȳðde hiere ðæt ic hīe nǣfre mā genēosian nolde.
Ðā rihtwīsan sindon swā bealde swā lēo.
Bryttas wǣron earge.
Cum hider, fægere fǣmne.
Ēadig is ðæt folc ðæs God is dryhten.
Leorniað æt mē, for-ðām ic eom mildheort and ēaðmōd on heortan, and gē gemētað ręste ēowrum sāwlum.
Nū ic sęnde ēow swā scēap gemang wulfas.
Ðonne hīe ēow ēhtað on ðisse ceastre, flēoð on ōðre.
Ic grēte mīnne ēðel.
